senses.gloss: --a queen of कृष्ण. Vi. V. २८. 3. [page१-010+ ५६]

(I)--the God of Fire also known as हुताशन, हव्यवाहन and Vahni.
1: भा., I. १५. 8; Br., III. १०. २४-35.
A place sacred to Agni in the Sara- स्वती which Vidura visited.
2: भा., III. 1. २२.
स्वाहा and her three sons are deities presiding over Agni.
3: Ib. IV. 1. ६०.
One of the gods with power to confer boons or pronounce curse on the world, curse on elephants.
4: Ib. IV. १४. २६-27; Br. III. 7, ३५२.
On the tail of शिशुमार.
5: भा., V. २३. 5; Br. II. २३. १०४.
Invested by the माया of भगवान्, Agni does not sometimes understand his will and work.
6: भा., VI. 3. १४. १५.
A guardian of the world.
7: Ib., VIII. १०. २६.
The mouth of Hari as embodying all Vedas.
8: Ib. VIII. १६. 9.
Is pleased with a devotee of Hari.
9: Ib. X. ४१. १३.
Even the powerful Agni could not digest ब्राह्मन्'s property when misappropriated.
१०: Ib. X. ६४. ३२.
Identified with Hari.
११: Ib. XI. १६. १३.
Swallowed the seed of शिव borne by गङ्गा as a punishment for disturbing उमा's union with the Lord, and unable to digest it, he discharged it into a bush of reeds (शरकानन) where it became कुमार.
१२: Ib. IV. 7. ६४[]; VI. 6. १४; Br. IV. १५. २१; २०. ४६; २६. ५३.
Goes round Dhruva.
१३: भा., IV. 9. २१.
Pre- sented आजगव bow to पृथु.
१४: Ib. IV. १५. १८.
Married a daughter of दक्ष.
१५: Ib. IV. 1. ४८.
Worshipped in कुशद्वीप.
१६: Ib. V. २०. 2.
His son was Manu स्वारोचिष.
१७: Ib. VIII. 1. १९.
Fought with Puloma in a देवासुर war,
१८: Ib. VIII. १०. ३१;
fol- lowed Indra's army against कृष्ण who took away पारिजात from heaven. Beaten by कृष्ण, he escaped alive from the field.
१९: Ib. X. [६५ (V) ४०]; [६६ (V) २७-31].
His town visited by Arjuna in search of a dead child of a ब्राह्मन् of द्वारका.
२०: Ib. X. ८९. ४४.

(II)--a लोकपाल: Gold pleasing to Agni; worship of;
1: M. २२५. १३; २६६. २०, ६३.
burning women and children in Tripura, he pleaded that he was not a free agent, but only carrying out orders.
2: M. १८८. २९-57.
The वम्श of Agni. The succession of fires and their descendants detailed in Ch. ५१ of the मत्स्य पुराण।
3: Cf. Mhb. Vana: २२०. 4.
The भागवत पुराण mentions ४९ Agnis. पावक, पवमान [page१-011+ २७] and शुचि and their ४५ sons together with स्वाहा. All invoked in sacrifices.
4: भा. IV. 1. ६०-62; 7, १६.
Another classification of fires: दिव्यम्, भौ- तिकम् or अब्योनि, and पार्थिवम्।
5: Br. II. २४. 6; २१. ५३. ५६; वा. ५३. 5.

(III)--one of the eight Vasus, and a son of Vasu. Wife वसोर्द्धार. द्रविणक and others are sons.
1: भा., VI. 6. ११, १३.
Identi- fied with Hari.
2: Ib. XI. १६. १३; M. 8. 4.
(IV)--married विकेशि. Father of ऊर्ज्ज clan of apsaras and also of Nala and अङ्गारक, who afterwards became a planet. Br. II. २४. ९१; III. 7. २१, २२९.
(V)--an आत्रेय, and one of the seven sages of तामस epoch. Br. II. ३६. ४७; M. 9. १५; वा. ६२. ४१.
(VI)--a son of आग्नेयी and ऊरु: His daughter Suc- छाया married शिष्ट, son of Dhruva: आर्षेय pravara. M. 4. ३८, ४३; १९६. 9.

(VII)--अलिअस् ऋत; son of Samvatsara;
1: Br. II. १३. २३.
married स्वाहा, a daughter of दक्ष.
2: वा. 1. ७६; Br. II. 9. ५६; १२. 1.
(VIII)--a Marut gana of that name. M. १७१. ५२. [page१-012+ ३२]

(X)--(भूतपति) one Agni made into three by Aila to attain the Gandharva loka in the त्रेतायुग. The Gandharvas presented him with a pot of Agni which he took to his city to perform sacrifices. He placed it on the अरणि when an अश्वत्थ appeared to his surprise. When Aila informed Gandharvas the latter asked him to turn the अश्वत्थ thrice and get three fires with which to sacrifice. वा. ९१. ४८: १०१. २१.
(XI)--see अनिल। Vi. I. १५. ११४.
(XII)--a महापुराण (also आग्नेय). Vi. III. 6. २२.
--see अग्नि। Vi. I. १०. १४.
--one of the three daughters of विक्रान्ता; origi- nator of the आग्नेय gan2a of the Gandharvas. वा. ६९. २१-23.

--the fire pot from which शिव appeared to दक्ष.
1: वा. ३०. १७२.
Rise of तिलोत्तमा from ब्रह्मा's अग्निकुण्ड.
2: वा. ६९. ५९.
--from which सीता came. वा. ८९. १७. [page१-013+ २५]
(I)--a daitya in the fifth talam (महातलम्- वा।). Br. II. २०. ३६; वा. ५०. ३५.

--the name of a hell to which disturbers of hermitages go;
1: Br. IV. 2. १४९, १७४.
those fallen from their आश्रम duties undergo torments in.
2: वा. १०१. १४८, १७१.
--on the southern bank of the यमुना. M. १०८. २७.
--a sage of the XI epoch of Manu. Vi. III. 2. ३१.
--a son of Bhautya Manu. वा. १००. ११६.
(I)--a नदीपुत्र and धिष्णि agni. Br. II. १२, २०. वा. २९. १८, २६.
(II)--(काश्यप)--a sage of the epoch of Bhautya Manu (XIVth Manu). Br. IV. 1. ११२; Vi. III. 2, ४४.

(III)--a son of स्वायम्भुव Manu.
1: वा. ३१. १७.
Lord of जम्बूद्वीप.
2: वा. ३३. 9, ११.
[page१-018+ ३०]

(I)--a son of Priyavrata and बर्हिष्मती. Father of नाभि. Appointed lord of जम्बूद्वीप.
1: भा. XI. 2. १५; V. 1. २५ and ३३.
Pro- tected the people like his children. Issueless, he performed तपस् when ब्रह्मा sent the divine damsel पूर्वचित्ति with whom आग्नीध्र enjoyed life for १००,000 years. After giv- ing birth to nine sons, she went back to the court of ब्रह्मा. He divided his kingdom among his sons, and rejoined his wife in another world. On his death, his nine sons married the nine daughters of Meru.
2: Ib. V. 2. 1-२३; Br. II. १४. ४४-53; Vi. II. 1. 7, १२, १६-24.
(III)--one of the ten sons of the daughter of Kardama, and Priyavrata. Br. II. १४. 9.
(IV)--one of the १६ ऋत्विक्स् for an यज्ञ; created from the hands of नारायण. M. १६७. १०.
--one among the महापुराणस् comprises १५४०० s4lokas. See अग्नि। भा., XII. 7. २३; १३. 5.
--the custom of wife entering her hus- band's funeral pyre. Br. III. ४७. ८२.
--diarrhoea--ययाति caused his son Anu to be afflicted by it. M. ३३. २४. [page१-014+ २८]
(I)--one of the ten sons of स्वायम्भुव Manu. Br. II. १३. १०४; M. 9. 4.
(II)--one of the ten sons of Kardama. Br. II. १४. 9.

(III) (भार्गव)--a sage of the epoch of Bhautya Manu;
1: Br. IV. 1. ११३.
a son of Bhautya (fourteenth) Manu.
2: वा. १००. ११६.
--an अमिताभ deva. Br. II. ३६, ५३.
--one of the fourteen sons of वसिष्ठ Praja1- pati in the चारिष्णव antara. वा. ६२. ४६.
(also अग्निमाठर)--a pupil of बाष्कल was instructed the second शाखा of the ऋग्वेद। वा. ६०. २६; Vi. III. 4. १८.
--one who keeps up the sacred fire. M. १६. २१.
--in होमस् to ward off calamities to the state. M. २३१. ११. [page१-015+ २४]
--a second disciple of बाष्कल, in charge of a शाखा of the ऋग्वेद। Br. II. ३४, २७.

(I)--the son of पुष्यमित्र S4un3ga and father of सुज्येष्ठ;
1: भा. XII. 1. १६; Vi. IV. २४. ३४-5.
reigned for eight years.
2: Br. III. ७४. १५१.
(II)--a pupil of बाष्कल. भा., XII. 6. ५४.
--the name of an Asura who has his city in the third talam. Br. II. २०. २६.
--a sage of the epoch of the १४थ् Manu (Agni बाहु) (Burnouf). भा. VIII. १३. ३४.
--from its middle महेश्वर spoke out the लिङ्ग पुराण। M. ५३. ३७-8.

--a sage:
1: Br. II. ३५. ६४.
a pupil of रोमहर्षण.
2: Vi. III. 6. १७.
--of the (कुश dynasty); the son of Sudar- शन, and father of शीघ्र(ga). भा. IX. १२. 5; Br. III. ६३. २०९-10; वा. ८८. २०९; Vi. IV. 4. १०८. [page१-016+ २८]

(I)--the son of Devadatta, was an incarnation of Agni. Was known also by other names--कानीन and जातूकर्ण. He was a great sage, and the originator of the ब्राह्मन् group of अग्निवेश्यायन.
1: भा., IX. 2. २१-22; Br. III. ४७. ४९.
(Pravara-अङ्गिरस्).
2: M. १९६. १२.
(II)--a son of शूलि in the २४थ् dva1para. वा. २३. २०७.
--a मानस r2tvik at ब्रह्मा's याग, created five Agnis from his face. वा. १०६. ३४, ४१.
--the originators of कश्यप gotra. M. १९९. 7.
(I)--produced by ब्रह्मा. भा., III. १२. ४०.
(II)--a son of चाक्षुष Manu. Br. II. ३६. ७९, १०६; M. 4. ४२.
--a son of Manu चाक्षुष and नड्वला. भा. IV. १३. १६: Vi. I. १३. 5.

--origin of, from the first face of ब्रह्मा;
1: Br. II. 8. ५०; वा. 9. ४९; Vi. I. 5. ५३.
performing अग्निष्टोमम् is equal to honouring पितृस्; done by वालि.
2: Br. III. 7. २६८; ११, ४३; १५. ११.
Here the sacrifice of पशु is involved.
3: M. ५३. ३३; ५८. ५३; २३९. ३०.
--a son of नाड्वलेय Manu. वा. ६२. ६७, ९१. [page१-017+ ४६]

--a पितृगण dwelling in the सोमपाद region in the direction of Vaivasvata.
1: भा. IV. 1. ६३; V. २६. 5; Vi. I. १०. १८; II. १२. १३; Br. II. १३. 6; वा. ७३. 2; ११०. १०.
पितृस् representing आर्त्तवस्, the name given to householders who do not per- form यज्ञस्।
2: Br. II. १३. 6-7; २३. ७५-77; २८. 4, १६, १९, २० and ७३; वा. ३०. 6, २७f; ५२. ६७-8; ५६. १३-15, ६८; ७३. 2-4.
पितृस् in Viraja's kingdom. Their mind-born daughter पीवरी was married by शुक, son of व्यास.
3: Br. III. १०. ७५-80.
Gave मेना their mind-born daughter to हिमवान्;
4: वा. ३०. २७-9, ३१; ५६. १३ and ६८; Vi. I. १०. १९; Br. II. १३. ३१.
overlord of other पितृस्.
5: M. १४. 2; १८. २१; १९. 5; १०२. २०; १२६. ६९; १४१. 4, १३ and १६.
--a कन्या गण born of Manu from ऊर्जा. वा. ६९. ५४.

--personified as the son of पृश्नि and सविता;
1: भा. VI. १८, 1.
a vedic sacrifice;
2: Ib. III, १३, ३६.
performed by Bharata.
3: Ib. V. 7, 5.
Its nature and effects.
4: Ib. VII. १५, ४८.
Performers of Agnihotra live in पितृयान;
5: Br. II. २१. १६०; ३०, १३; III. १४, 2; २६, १४; ३५, ४४; ४४, 5; ६६, 2; M. १२४. ९८.
per- formed by शुक्र, धूमिनी, the sonless wife of अजमीढ;
6: M. ११, ५८; २५, ३४; ५०, १८; १०७, १६; १८३, ८१.
performed by पुरूरवस्;
7: वा. ९१, 2; १०७, १८; ७७, 9.
the face of the personified Vedas.
8: Ib. १०४, ८३.
As efficacious as hearing the विष्णुपुराण once.
9: Vi. VI. 8, ३०.
offered to Agni, Soma and Yama in the श्राद्ध; the पितृस्थानम् of places pre- scribed. M. १५. ३२; १६. ३३.
--an attribute of शिव, अग्नीषोमन् representing Brahman. Br. III. ७२. १८८; IV. ४३. ७६.
--Vedic rituals which are to begin on पर्वसन्धिस्। M. १४१. ३२.
--कश्यपगोत्रकरस्. M. १९९. 8.
--a goddess, wife of दिक्पाल Agni. M. २८६. 7. [page१-146+ ३२]
--a sage of the epoch of the XIIth Manu. भा. VIII. १३. २८.
--a ब्रह्म-कुल originating from जातूकर्ण. भा. IX. 2. २२.
--the first गान्धार-ग्राम। वा. ८६. ४१.
(II)--a division of the night. वा. ६६. ४३.

(I)--the Gandharva followers of Kubera;
1: वा. ४०. 8.
their residences on the southern peaks of मर्यादा Parvata.
2: वा. ४०. 5.
(II)--the अङ्गिरस् adopted by Agni when they sprung out of the sacrificial fire of वारुणी-यज्ञ। वा. ६५. ४२.

--one among the eighteen पुराणस्;
1: भा. XII. 7. २३.
deals with ईशान कल्प; narrated by Agni to वसिष्ठ: of १६,000 verses; its gift and fruits thereof.
2: M. ५३. २८-30.
--of kings; ruin rebellious सामन्तस् by his valour. M. २२६. 7.
--given to Sagara by भार्गव (Aurva). वा. ८८. १२४ and १३५; Vi. IV. 3. ३७.
(I)--the city of Agni. भा. X. ८९. ४४.
(II)--the wife of हविर्धान, and mother of six children: also known as धिषणा. Br. II. ३७. २३; वा. ६३. २३; Vi. I. १४. 2; M. 4. ४५.
(III)--the wife of ऊरु. M. 4. ४३.
(IV)--the wife of Kuru and mother of six sons. Vi. I. १३. 6. [page१-148+ ३०]
